verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU cloud platform, so registrable outbound webhooks are a fair axis to ask about, but nothing in the evidence pack documents subscribing to events via webhooks. The REST API, GraphQL API, SDKs, CLI and MCP servers are pull-style management interfaces, not outbound HTTP event callbacks, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
